analysis:
Examined all 29 primary analyses and all eight replayed source units. Replay omits 134 reviewed units, so most implementation claims cannot be independently verified here. No concrete regression is established by the available source; tests, documentation and prior analyses are not proof of production enforcement.

Verified release-provider.yml HEAD 941–977 adds execution of the final archived app after bundle-hash verification, signing-keychain deletion and an identity-absence check. HEAD 1078–1088 includes cluster facts only under the environment-specific opt-in and requires a nonempty file. Disabled-lane computation failures are advisory; enabled failures block normal publication. These controls answer workflow-gating questions, but do not alone establish filesystem credential isolation or authenticity of emitted qualifications. CI and dev/staging trigger changes add script execution/coverage without visibly changing permissions.

Remaining material review: inspect the facts producer, metadata fetcher and publication validator together (scripts/provider-cluster-runtime-facts.sh:28–37, provider-cluster-runtime-models.py:109–185, provider-release-publication.py:71–228, as identified by the analyses). Verify exact artifact/model binding and distinguish release-declared pair/parity qualifications from independent build qualification and current serving authorization (A-005, A-017, TB-011, T-052/T-054/T-056). The new coordinator-derived cluster qualification contract may need explicit threat-model coverage; missing platform enforcement is not a demonstrated bypass.

Runtime evidence remains necessary for ClusterPublicModels/DistributedInstalledPairServingGrant admission versus status wording, assistant exclusion across scope planning and approval attachment, and ClusterService.swift HEAD 1131–1133, 1428–1463. Reconcile hourly retries with expiry, revocation, worker identity and fresh connection authorization (T-053), and child environments with the persistent cache opt-out (T-041). Replay establishes intended retry/heartbeat behavior, not its enforcement. No supplied replay demonstrates changed plaintext exposure, billing, cache cryptography or privileged-helper authority.
